title: Pakistan banking and payments: real-data analysis

sections.title: Overview
sections.intro: Real data only (SBP, World Bank, BIS, ECB, FRED, Global Findex). The first tab holds the synthetic NovaBank payments dashboard; nothing on this tab is synthetic.

sections.title: Macro and monetary
sections.intro: Growth is modest and volatile (3.05% average over five years). Reserves rebuilt to 2.88x the June 2023 low; the rupee has been stable near 277. The current account moved from a surplus to a US$ 391m deficit in FY26.

sections.title: Banking system
sections.intro: Capital is solid and the gross NPL ratio is 5.57%, but 83.3% of NPLs are in the 'loss' category and doubtful NPLs are rising. Banks lend about 36.1% of deposits and roughly 73% of credit goes to government.

sections.title: Payments
sections.intro: Digital channels carry 92.4% of retail volume but 40.4% of value. Wallet apps are 58.5% of volume; ATM volume is flat while card-present POS grew 45% in a year.

sections.title: Cross-border finance
sections.intro: External debt is US$ 135.1bn; IDS scheduled service is US$ 24.8bn in 2026. Remittances cost 2.61% on average, but banks charge 6.29% against 2.46% for money-transfer operators.

sections.title: Financial inclusion
sections.intro: Only 27.3% of adults have an account (rank 148 of 153). 11.9% of women do, the lowest of all economies; the gender gap is 30.4 points, the second largest.

sections.title: Data quality
sections.intro: 13 of 16 checks pass; the rest are explained by differing periods or cannot be tested from these files. SBP tables come from OCR and have not been checked cell by cell against the PDFs.
